Typography

Typography

Inter Tight handles display and headings (geometric, tight tracking). Inter handles body (more legible apertures at small sizes). JetBrains Mono for kickers, meta, and code.

Lead · Inter 400 / 18px

Long-form writing. Published slowly, revised often. The ones I’d still send to a friend.

Body · Inter 400 / 16px

The first month with NVDA always sounds like a fire alarm. The sixth month sounds like a colleague, politely listing what you’ve broken. That gap, in either direction, is where craft lives, neither in the wiring nor in the words, but in the patience to hear both.

Prose decorations

Prose decorations

Used inside essay readers to set mood without cluttering the page.

Drop cap openers introduce an essay with a single oversized letterform that floats against the first paragraph. The rest of the paragraph wraps around it and recovers its normal weight by the second sentence, which is when most readers settle in.

A focus ring is the smallest, most visible contract a designer can make with a stranger. , from an internal talk, feb 2026

Inline marginalia in the right gutter, hidden below 1200px:

this is the “taste” trap When in doubt, write what would you say to a colleague and then take a third of it out. The shape that remains is usually the essay.

Highlighted text uses the warm honey highlight token.

The focus ring is a social contract
